d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

You will support a risk-based monitoring programme across in-scope processes and controls, working alongside the Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment team and Compliance business units to assess control criticality, determine monitoring frequency, and support delivery of the annual monitoring plan. You will also support periodic reviews to assess whether controls are operating as designed, and help document outcomes for feedback.
q: 1–3 years of experience in risk, controls, compliance, audit or a related area.
Basic understanding of internal controls and control effectiveness concepts.
Strong attention to detail, documentation and organisational skills.
Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
Experience in financial services or a regulated environment is an advantage.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

r: Run the monitoring plan — execute the risk-based monitoring plan across all in-scope processes and controls.
QA the frontline work — test retail and corporate transaction monitoring alerts and KYC files.
Test control effectiveness — assess whether controls are properly designed and operating effectively, including input into control criticality assessments and the monitoring frequency matrix.
Document everything — record results, observations, findings and improvement areas accurately, and independently manage and resolve disputed QA findings.
Report and track — prepare reports and MI, and track follow-up actions, remediation items and outstanding issues through to closure.
Coordinate across teams — work with Transaction Monitoring, SAR Investigations and KYC teams (local and offshore), and keep process consistent across jurisdictions.
Flag risk and upskill — identify unusual activity and AML flags, support risk assessments, periodic/trigger reviews and EDD, and take part in AML/CFT training.

d: We are seeking an experienced Digital Solutions Manager on behalf of one of our clients in Bahrain.
The successful candidate will lead the development and delivery of digital solutions that support business strategy, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer and employee experiences.

The role will oversee the digital solutions portfolio, driving initiatives across enterprise applications, digital platforms, workflow automation, data analytics, system integration, and artificial intelligence, while ensuring security, scalability, governance, and measurable business value.
Develop and execute the digital solutions strategy, portfolio, and roadmap in alignment with business objectives.
Lead the evaluation, design, implementation, integration, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital platforms.
Collaborate with business leaders to identify technology needs, streamline processes, and deliver effective digital solutions.
Drive digital transformation initiatives across workflow automation, business intelligence, data analytics, cloud solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.
Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data privacy, governance, and business continuity requirements.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, and delivery performance.
Oversee solution lifecycles, enhancements, system upgrades, user adoption, and performance monitoring.
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary digital solutions team.
Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business outcomes and operational value.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in digital solutions, enterprise applications, technology delivery, or digital transformation.
At least 3 years of experience in a managerial or team leadership role.
Proven experience managing digital transformation projects, enterprise applications, SaaS solutions, system integrations, and technology portfolios.
Strong understanding of workflow automation, low-code platforms, data analytics, AI, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.
Experience in vendor management, stakeholder engagement, project delivery, and change management.
Good knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, data protection, and enterprise architecture.
